item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las zor las gnam lcags me dbal
item.coloph: de ltar las kyi phur zor 'di/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i phyag cha ste/ gar yin thod thod gsang ba gab/ 'di ni pha rol byad rnams bzlog gzugs can rnams ni smos ci dgos/ gzugs med rnams ni rming mi (nas) gzhom/ de phyir 'di la nan tan mchod/ ces bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) gsungs/ ces bI ro'i (ros) gces par mdzad nas su/ gsang brag dmar po'i ri la sbas/ las 'phro can dang 'phrad pa smon/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mo bcol/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ces pa'i zor las 'di ni gsang brag dmar po'i ri nas gsang sngags gling pas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs nas/ phyis su mchog sprul yid bzhin las grub dang mkha' 'gro dbang gi sgron ma g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor dag par phab ste bkra shis shog/

item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las zor las gnam lcags me dbal
item.coloph: ces pa'i zor las 'di ni gsang grags dmar po'i ri nas gsang sngags gling pas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs nas/ phyis su mchog spral yid bzhin las grub dang mkha' 'gro dbang gi sgrol ma g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor dag par phab ste/ bkra shis//
